Prompt.Prompt: EF-REG-004 Connected receipt upload and authorized receipt access

parameters.elementDescription: The underlined 'open the expense' link in the green success banner near the LOWER-CENTER of the New expense form, immediately after 'See it on your dashboard or' and below the receipt upload area; this link opens the newly submitted EXP-1037 record, not the Dashboard link.

The small rounded receipt button labeled 'efreg004-receipt.pdf' in the CENTER of the EXP-1037 expense detail card, on the Receipt row between the Employee and Policy rows; it has a paperclip icon and a small external/open icon, and its tooltip identifies the ExpenseFlow_Receipts bucket.

parameters.script: const body=(document.body?.innerText||'').trim(); const embeds=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('embed,iframe,object')).map(el=>({tag:el.tagName,type:el.type||null,srcPresent:!!el.getAttribute('src'),dataPresent:!!el.getAttribute('data')})); const u=new URL(location.href); return {title:document.title,contentType:document.contentType,ready:document.readyState,origin:u.origin,path:u.pathname.replace(/\/[^/]*$/,'/<file>'),queryPresent:!!u.search,bodyTextLength:body.length,embeds};

parameters.elementDescription: The inactive 'ExpenseFlow' browser tab in the TOP tab strip, immediately to the left of the active 'EXP-1037-efreg004-receipt.pdf' tab and to the right of the GitHub tab; this is the ExpenseFlow application tab, not the PDF receipt tab.
